purpose: Local reference for owner-authored chapter-to-set mapping. Not a runtime content manifest or redistribution approval.

coverage.scope: All records returned by unfiltered provider cardsets.php and cardinfo.php at fetch time. Default provider-language dataset; not a guarantee of exhaustive worldwide/OCG/Rush/alternate-art coverage.
setsWithoutMembershipRecords: Yu-Gi-Oh! Power of Chaos: Yugi the Destiny Limited Collector's Edition
coverage.ordering: sets: tcgReleaseDate ascending, missing dates last, then name; cards: name then id; reprints retained as memberships, same card id can occur in many sets.
limitations: TCG release dates are provider metadata, not authoritative chapter/era boundaries.
sourceReportedCardCount may count print variants differently from uniqueCardCount; values preserved, never silently reconciled.
One membership-only set is preserved with null set metadata rather than omitted.
Cards without provider set membership are listed separately; owner must assign or exclude explicitly.
No art bytes, art download, price data, chapter assignments, or engine-compatibility guarantee included.
API technical access does not establish permission to redistribute names, text, images or underlying data.
